meta.note: Primary sources only. EU-8 = Eurostat COMEXT DS-045409 (EUR, qty in 100kg converted to kg); United Kingdom = HMRC uktradeinfo OTS (GBP, kg); UN Comtrade used as an independent cross-check (USD). valueUsd is converted from native currency at the ECB reference rate given in fxToUsd; valueNative/nativeCcy hold the unconverted figure. Quantities are NET MASS in kg. Shares are quantity-based. WARNING 1: Netherlands and Belgium include quasi-transit trade (Rotterdam/Antwerp effect) and are 25-42% above the same country's UN Comtrade declaration - do not treat as domestic consumption. WARNING 2: 2026 is PARTIAL and periods differ - EU = Jan-Apr, UK = Jan-May and Jan-Apr; never sum across them. No estimation or interpolation: missing items are absent, not filled.

fx.note: ECB reference rates; GBP->USD is cross-derived as (USD/EUR)/(GBP/EUR)
